claims.content: Auctioneer
The user is the Auction Merchandiser/Scheduler (the "Auctioneer").
The Auctioneer has searched for and selected a list of auction products.
The Auctioneer wants to create a new promotional event.

trigger.raw_text: The Auctioneer wants to create a new promotional event.

claims.content: The Auctioneer edits the selected auction items, with editable fields shown in gray.
The Auctioneer navigates from field-to-field using the TAB key, arrow keys, or mouse.
The Auctioneer copies-and-pastes data between fields.
Once the auction group is created, the Auctioneer applies an 'event profile' to the group or creates the auction manually.
If creating manually, the Auctioneer sets each item's opening bid, bid increment, duration, and ending time.
The Auctioneer chooses an auction duration from standard durations (e.g., 20-Minute to 30 Day) or schedules alternative durations by manually choosing starting and ending dates/times.
Once the duration and ending time are filled in, the opening time is system-generated (calculated).
The system provides a warning, preferably via a popup window, if any items being scheduled have additional quantities of the same item already scheduled in overlapping auction events.

The Auctioneer may use the Auto-Scheduler capability to randomly choose product and schedule product from an available list over a timeframe chosen by the Auctioneer, using any parameters given by the Auctioneer. The auto-scheduler capability is able to randomly schedule auction ending times – down to 5 minute intervals.

If the Auctioneer chooses a radio button to apply a profile to a specific category (e.g., 'Apply to Gemstones Only') and later tries to apply the profile to a grouping of items in a different category (e.g., jewelry), the system generates an error message telling her that this profile can only be applied to products in the gemstone category.

The scheduling application does not allow the Auctioneer to create an auction with the same starting & ending date / time. This results in an error message, and the system highlights (color-code) the offending data.
If products appear in a search that do not have an available image to display or are not in a valid, sellable inventory location, they are not eligible for scheduling.

If, for example, she chooses, 'Apply to Gemstones Only', and then later tries to apply the profile to a grouping of jewelry items, the system will generate an error message telling her that this profile can only be applied to products in the gemstone category (retail category = gemstones).

The scheduling application should never allow the Auctioneer to create an auction with the same starting & ending date / time. This should result in an error message, and the system should highlight (color-code) the offending data.

The system should provide some type of warning, preferably via a popup window, to the Auctioneer before the auction is created if any of the items being scheduled have additional quantities of the same item already scheduled in overlapping auction events.
An auction group is created.
The opening time is system-generated (calculated).
Standard durations are available in the standard reporting criteria.
A schedule and parameters are created for the selected SKUs.
